dashboard.tagline: Pick a game and beat your best score

2048.description: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers to reach 2048.

snake.title: Snake
snake.description: Guide the neon snake, eat the food and grow as long as you can.

minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
minesweeper.description: Clear the minefield without setting off a mine. Numbers tell you how many mines are hiding nearby.

game2048.instruction: HOW TO PLAY: Use arrow keys (desktop) or swipe (mobile) to move tiles. Same numbers merge into one!

snake.guideMove: Use arrow keys to move the snake
snake.pressToStart: Press an arrow key to start

minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
minesweeper.lostMessage: Sorry, you lost this game. Better luck next time!
minesweeper.newBestTime: You have the fastest time for this level!
minesweeper.customNoStats: Statistics are not kept for custom games.
minesweeper.inProgressMessage: What do you want to do with the game in progress?
minesweeper.quitAndStart: Quit and start a new game
minesweeper.quitNote: This counts as a loss in your statistics.
minesweeper.resetConfirm: Reset all statistics? This cannot be undone.
minesweeper.help1: Open every tile that does not hide a mine to win. Your first click is always safe.
minesweeper.help2: A number tells you how many mines touch that tile, including diagonals.
minesweeper.help3: Right-click (or long-press on a touch screen) to flag a tile you think hides a mine. Right-click again for a question mark.
minesweeper.help4: Click a number whose mines are all flagged to open every tile around it at once.
minesweeper.help5: Click the smiley face or press F2 for a new game. F4 opens statistics, F5 opens options.
